decision_basis: Discovery-only Phase 4A v2 audit completed. No validation cohort, candidate identity list, L1-L2-L3 output, known PPI label, pathway label, or external evidence was used to choose this formula.

input.eligible_universe: proteins with complete primary GSE75097 OSA-state, severe-state, and AHI evidence

evidence_transform.source_statistic: moderated two-sided raw P from the registered primary contrast
evidence_transform.strength: midrank percentile of -log10(P) within the source-specific available protein universe: (average_rank - 0.5) / N
evidence_transform.direction: sign(beta) retained separately and never converted into one-sided significance
evidence_transform.FDR_interpretation: no primary source has FDR<0.05; selected proteins are evidence-prioritized candidates, not significant DE proteins

adult_OSA_axis.rationale: OSA state is the primary disease anchor; severe state and continuous AHI form one severity branch and therefore jointly receive the other half rather than being triple-counted.

IH_axis.missing_interpretation: neutral/no information, not zero evidence and not imputed biological support

stability_not_used_for_selection: primary versus adjusted beta correlation/sign agreement
primary versus all-48 beta correlation/sign agreement
primary IH versus exclude-subject-403 correlation/sign agreement
primary IH versus detection-threshold correlation/sign agreement

preliminary_matched_controls.ratio: 1 control per primary candidate without replacement
preliminary_matched_controls.method: deterministic greedy nearest-neighbour in standardized covariates, processed by primary candidate rank

prohibited: using CPAP, adipose, single-cell, proteome, known-PPI, pathway, or model outputs to alter candidate membership
calling the top 250 or 500 statistically significant proteins
changing weights after viewing validation enrichment
using preliminary controls as final controls before model-asset availability matching
